A letter for you

Dear Madam,

Happy Birthday to my favourite person. ❤️

I don't know if I can ever put everything I feel for you into the right words, but aaj tumhara special day hai, so I had to try. You have this very simple way of making my day better — sometimes just by talking to me, sometimes by smiling, and sometimes bas tumhara ek chhota sa message hi kaafi hota hai.

With you, even the little things start feeling important. I love the way our conversations become memories without us even noticing. And honestly, Madam, tum meri life ka woh part ban gayi ho jiske bina din thoda incomplete sa lagta hai.

Maybe I don't say it perfectly every time, but I genuinely care about you. I want to see you happy, confident, smiling and doing all the things you dream about. Tomar hashi ta emni korei thakuk, aar tomar shob shopno ek ek kore puro hok. 🌸

Thank you for being you. Thank you for being my Munu. And thank you for letting your Shivu have a little place in your world.

On your birthday, I just want one thing for you — stay happy, stay the same beautiful soul, and never forget how special you are.

Always cheering for you,
— Your Shivu ❤️

Happy Birthday, Munu. 🎂✨
